The '''Armored Whisper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha savant]] who was freed from imprisonment in [[the Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The Armored Whisper was among the [[Esh-kha]] warriors who took over the canyon known as [[the Scar]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Armored Whisper is the target of the final stage of "The Scar," an Area mission for Imperial players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
